Food safety body issues notices for misleading claims and labeling

India's food safety regulator, FSSAI, has issued notices to multiple companies, including Lotte India and Ferns N Petals, for alleged misleading claims and labeling violations. The notices indicate concerns over how products are presented to consumers. This action by FSSAI highlights ongoing efforts to ensure compliance with food safety and advertising standards in the market.
